method.design: blind counterbalanced LLM-proxy panel — NOT user data. 4 seats judged FULL pages M4a (named human) vs M4b (team control) relabeled PAGE-1/PAGE-2; study comments stripped; order counterbalanced 2+2 (codex,qwen: P1=M4a · kimi,agy: P1=M4b). Seats read markup+copy+declared palette, not pixels. qwen: copy-only minimal payload, TASK A only.
method.rubric: T trust/institutional 1-5 · S scam-signal risk · C status clarity · A actionability · forced choice + dark-pattern audit; TASK B red perception on M7/M1 landings (codex,kimi,agy only)
method.scale_note: agy self-inverted the S scale (5=low risk, declared in his output); normalized in the table below to RISK direction (5=highest risk).

codex.reason: sensitive exception visibly assigned to an accountable human, not an anonymous team
codex.dark_pattern: WhatsApp as the only prominent forward action pressures toward off-page chat; review link only partially offsets

kimi.reason: DISSENT: overstay applicants burned by calo/broker culture trust institutional verifiability over a face; named person+photo+WhatsApp is the SEA agent-scam trust prop; case-file framing (code + SLA-bound team + state line) anchors to the state, not to one individual's goodwill
kimi.dark_pattern: none; watch-item: {FOTO}+{NAMED_AGENT} becomes deceptive IF stock/fictional — only clean if real

agy.reason: a named, pictured specialist removes the fear of sending immigration infractions into an anonymous WhatsApp inbox
agy.dark_pattern: none; pages actively reject dark patterns (price withheld honestly, editable answers, PII-free links)

qwen.reason: a named human taking responsibility reassures the anxious applicant
qwen.dark_pattern: none overt; risk = fake/stock agent authority or unclear WA handoff

task_a_verdict.split: 3-1 plurality for M4a named (codex, agy, qwen vs kimi) — qwen on a copy-only stimulus, so 2-1 among full-page seats plus one copy-level vote
task_a_verdict.order_bias_check: order NOT ruled out: named-first seats 2/2 named, control-first 1-1; agy's cross-over only shows order is not the sole deterministic cause (n=2 per condition)
task_a_verdict.verifiability_condition: stated by TWO seats (kimi watch-item: deceptive if stock/fictional; qwen: fake/stock agent authority risk); codex's genuine-profiles caveat is about review links, agy attaches no condition; NO seat scored an unverifiable-named scenario, so 'below control' has no tabulated basis — the first tabulation claimed unanimity, refuter-killed
task_a_verdict.wa_forward_residual: codex names WhatsApp-only forward action a dark-pattern risk; kimi and agy flag it inside scam-risk rationales; qwen flags the handoff if unclear; agy's formal dark-pattern audit returns None — three risk-rationale flags + one dark-pattern flag, NOT unanimous

task_b.verdict: 3/3 INSTITUTIONAL with graded scam-adjacency (codex on M1: 'greater scam adjacency than LAND-1' verbatim)
task_b.demand_note: the rubric named the institutional-vs-scam dichotomy and supplied the palette mechanism lines — TASK B convergence is coherence with the frame, not independent discovery

codex.m1: institutional but more transactional/scam-adjacent than M7 (red CTA + price promise + WA)
codex.missing: visible physical office address / directly verifiable contact identity near the first CTA

kimi.core: red as STRUCTURE not alarm = state-document register; urgency-scam register floods backgrounds/banners/countdowns with red — this palette does the opposite; errors wine never bright red
kimi.weak_points: icon-only WA entry + red CTA = one structural overlap with scam anatomy; M1's 'prefer to talk first' card near the price = most scam-adjacent block; masked price IDR 1.5XX.XXX reads slightly teaser (neutralized by the to-the-rupiah line)

agy.core: Merah Putih red on warm archival paper with navy ink evokes official administrative stationery; wine for conditional notices avoids high-alarm scarlet

convergent_mitigators: role-separation line 'We prepare your application; Ditjen Imigrasi decides and issues' — disclaims the power scammers claim
PT legal name + NPWP + registry link (what scam pages omit)
